propositions: transition_close.py exceeds 800-LOC hard cap at 803 LOC, causing CI Module-size gate to fail and blocking all Gerrit changes from reaching Verified +1

The completion-precheck verification cluster (_completion_precheck, _referencing_commit_exists, _is_live_ticket, _has_live_replacement_link, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) forms a self-contained call-graph seam that can be extracted into a sibling module without behavioral change
The four functions in the precheck cluster are only called internally by each other and by close_ticket, with no external cross-module imports or references outside the cluster
Extracting the precheck cluster to a new module and importing it back into transition_close preserves monkeypatch behavior and dynamic symbol resolution in close_ticket through module-level binding
